_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: a subdirectory .dockerignore is not detected by any guard (undetected, issue #1891)
expectedRed.why: On correct code the guard names apps/api/.dockerignore and exits 1; the assertion that the guard exits 0 fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the subdirectory .dockerignore silence (no guard detecting it at all) is back.
